question: Select the correct pair of classical dance and dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Subrahmanyam – Bharatnatyam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bharatnatyam dance origin can be traced back to The solo dance of temple dancers or devadasis in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Bharatnatyam is also known as **Dashiattam**.
 
• **Elements of Bharatnatyam**
 
 
• Alarippu-seeking blessing of god with simple dance steps in rhythm.
 
• Jatiswaram-Nritta component with devoid expression.
 
• Shabdam-dramatic element with expressed words.
 
• Combination of dance and emotion to express a story.
 
• Padam-mastery over abhinaya of a spiritual message by the artist.
 
• Jawali-Its performed with short love lyrics at a fast tempo.
 
• Thillana-Its is known as the concluding Stage with pure dance(Nritta).
 
 
 
• Padma Subramaniam is related to the Bharatnatyam dance.​​__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• ​Padma Subrahmanyam is an Indian classical Bharata Natyam dancer.
 
• She is also a research scholar, choreographer, teacher, Indologist and author.
 
• She is famous in India and also abroad; several films and documentaries have been made in her honour by countries such as Japan, Australia and Russia.
 
• The Padma received Padma Shri in 1981 and Padma Bhushan in 2003, which are among the highest civilian awards of India.
